Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for KSPCB Environmental Engineer Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is being conducted by the Kerala State Pollution Control Board (KSPCB) for various posts. It is a government job opportunity in Kerala.

faq.question: Q2. What is the post name for this KSPCB recruitment?
faq.answer: The post name for this KSPCB recruitment is Environmental Engineer. Candidates with relevant qualifications can apply for this position.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are available for Environmental Engineer posts?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy available for the Environmental Engineer post in the Kerala State Pollution Control Board recruitment drive. Interested candidates should check the notification for details.

faq.question: Q4. What is the mode of application for KSPCB Environmental Engineer recruitment?
faq.answer: The mode of application for KSPCB Environmental Engineer recruitment is Walk-in. Candidates need to attend an interview directly on the specified date.

faq.question: Q5. What is the walk-in interview date for Environmental Engineer posts?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview for Environmental Engineer posts is scheduled for 29 September 2026. Candidates must report at the venue with all necessary documents.

faq.question: Q6. What is the maximum age limit for the Environmental Engineer post?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Environmental Engineer post is 28 years. Candidates must ensure they meet this age criterion before attending the interview.

faq.question: Q7. What is the required qualification for the Environmental Engineer position?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a B.Tech degree in Civil, Chemical, or Environmental Engineering to be eligible for the Environmental Engineer position at KSPCB.

faq.question: Q8. What is the salary offered for the Environmental Engineer post?
faq.answer: The salary offered for the Environmental Engineer post is Rs. 10000 per month. This is a contractual position with a fixed monthly remuneration.

faq.question: Q9. Is there any application fee for KSPCB Environmental Engineer recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee for KSPCB Environmental Engineer recruitment for any category, including General/OBC and SC/ST candidates. The application is free.

faq.question: Q10. What is the selection process for Environmental Engineer at KSPCB?
faq.answer: The selection process for Environmental Engineer at KSPCB involves a Walk-in Interview followed by Document Verification. Candidates will be assessed based on their performance in the interview.
